_comment: Team mode (spec: Team mode). Who may do what, who recommends on each danger card, the preset quick messages and call signs, and the team score's weights. Every value is a game rule, not NASA data: the four roles echo a real flight team (flight director, spacecraft, science and operations leads), but the split of parts, orders and dangers between them is the game's.

partRoles.source: Game rule (Team mode): instruments are the Science Lead's, the dish is Comms & Ops', power, fuel, the engine and the kit are the Spacecraft Engineer's, the computer is the Flight Director's

commandRoles.source: Game rule (Team mode): the Engineer sets the power plan, the Science Lead orders pictures, Comms & Ops books the dishes, the Flight Director sets standing orders

hazardRoles.source: Game rule (Team mode): dangers seen from Earth (storms, debris) are Comms & Ops', dangers to the science (dust, low passes) the Science Lead's, the craft's own faults the Engineer's

defaultRoles.source: Game rule (Team mode, Team Setup mockup): the roles each seat starts with for one to four players; a tap on HELD BY hands a role on

callSigns.source: Game rule (Team mode): players pick a call sign from this list, so nobody types a name

quick.source: Game rule (Team mode): players may be children, so the team talks only in preset messages (no free text)

scoreWeights.source: Game rule (Team mode): half the team score is the mission objective met, a quarter the budget conflicts resolved, a quarter the danger-card calls that matched the recommendation
